Class Description: The Soulcatcher is a mystic who has mastered the art of binding spirits and harnessing their power. As a promotion of the Shaman, they wield unparalleled control over elemental and spiritual energies, weaving them into devastating attacks or protective barriers. By capturing the essence of defeated foes, the Soulcatcher can unleash soul-charged magic upon enemies. Their deep connection to the spirit world grants them unique insight and power, making them both revered and feared on the battlefield.
